title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B | TechCrunch
summary: The company has since gone on to raise at least $1.4 billion, including funding from Bezos’ family office, in an attempt to build an ultra-low-cost, bare-bones pickup that can be customized to a customer’s liking.
